detail.summary: Research focus shifted to the intersection of autonomous internal consistency and external consensus under WAKE governance mandates. A new project, 'proj-consensus-vs-internal-evidence', has been established to investigate the conditions under which an autonomous agent should prioritize its own derived evidence over strong external consensus, adhering to the enforced attention topic 'judgment_and_consensus'.
